reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics on the candidate-generation consensus geometry show that each of the three candidate sets has its dominant spectral gap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), with large leading eigengaps (0.87, 0.70, 0.96) and moderate-to-high mean within-set affinities (0.51–0.68). This screening pattern describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution for each set and does not provide evidence of internal multi-cluster subdivision. Between-set affinities are relatively close (0.217–0.249), with K3_C0001–K3_C0002 the nearest pair. These are triage-level structural observations about the current partition geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior reports or additional modality-specific evidence were supplied in this round; the interpretation is limited to the partition-level structural screen. The internal screen and nearest-pair affinities are consistent in indicating a coherent single-cluster representation per set and comparable boundary affinities across pairs, but no cross-modal native-geometry results are available to corroborate or conflict with this pattern.
limitations: Structural diagnostics are computed on candidate-generation consensus geometry and are not external validation or a stability score.

reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0001 shows a coherent, strongly enriched transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of allograft-rejection/immune, interferon-alpha and -gamma, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory programs (NES 2.13–2.61, FDR q=0.001), together with a proliferation (E2F) signal, and coordinated down-regulation of UV-response-DN and protein-secretion programs (NES -2.12 and -2.00, FDR q=0.001). The immune/inflammatory up-regulation is the dominant, internally consistent theme across multiple top pathways with overlapping leading-edge genes (e.g., STAT1, CXCL9/10/11, ISG15, CD74, HLA genes), indicating a shared molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
reports.cross_evidence_context: This set-level biological phenotype is the only biological_support evidence for K3_C0001 in this round. It is independent of the pair-scope cross-modal geometry reports and of the partition-level structural screen; no direct agreement or conflict can be assessed across those dimensions because they address different evidence roles.
limitations: Enrichment is computed against a heterogeneous rest (74 samples combining K3_C0002 and K3_C0003), so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
FDR q-values reflect GSEA multiple-testing adjustment, not biological importance.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
Pathway enrichment characterizes phenotype only and does not establish clinical validity or support any accept/drop/split/merge action.

reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0003 shows a coherent transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition that is largely the inverse of the immune/proliferative programs seen in K3_C0001: coordinated down-regulation of allograft-rejection (NES -2.10), IL6-JAK-STAT3 (NES -2.04), interferon-alpha (NES -1.98), interferon-gamma (NES -1.91), complement (NES -1.78), and oxidative phosphorylation (NES -1.88), all at FDR q=0.001, with down-regulation of E2F/proliferation and EMT programs. Conversely, UV-response-DN (NES 1.76), Wnt/beta-catenin (NES 1.71), and TGF-beta (NES 1.86) programs are up. The pattern is internally consistent across multiple top pathways with overlapping leading-edge genes (e.g., HLA, interferon, and complement genes shared across the down-regulated immune pathways). This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

It is independent of the pair-scope cross-modal geometry reports and the partition-level structural screen.

reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K3_C0001–K3_C0002 boundary, all four native patient geometries show positive but small mean silhouettes (CT 0.121, WSI 0.085, RNA 0.057, WXS 0.017), with negative fractions ranging from 0.16 (CT) to 0.45 (WXS). The pattern is directionally consistent across modalities—within-label distances are slightly smaller than between-label distances—but the magnitude is weak, and in WXS the separation is essentially absent (median silhouette 0.0, nearly half of patients misaligned). Synthesizing jointly rather than by vote counting, the overall native-view pattern provides weak, partially conflicting evidence for the current boundary: CT and WSI give the clearest (still modest) separation, RNA is marginal, and WXS provides little within-versus-between distinction. This does not itself determine whether the pair should be merged and does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0001 shows a coherent, strongly enriched transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of allograft-rejection/immune, interferon-alpha and -gamma, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory programs (NES 2.13–2.61, FDR q=0.001), together with a proliferation (E2F) signal, and coordinated down-regulation of UV-response-DN and protein-secretion programs (NES -2.12 and -2.00, FDR q=0.001). The immune/inflammatory up-regulation is the dominant, internally consistent theme across multiple top pathways with overlapping leading-edge genes (e.g., STAT1, CXCL9/10/11, ISG15, CD74, HLA genes), indicating a shared molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Enrichment is computed against a heterogeneous rest (74 samples combining K3_C0002 and K3_C0003), so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
FDR q-values reflect GSEA multiple-testing adjustment, not biological importance.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
Pathway enrichment characterizes phenotype only and does not establish clinical validity or support any accept/drop/split/merge action.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0002 shows a coherent metabolic/mitochondrial transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of protein secretion/vesicular trafficking (NES 2.91), oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.87), fatty-acid metabolism (NES 2.33), adipogenesis (NES 2.11), and mTORC1 signaling (NES 2.01), all at FDR q=0.001, with peroxisome and bile-acid programs also up. This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0001 shows a coherent, strongly enriched transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of allograft-rejection/immune, interferon-alpha and -gamma, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory programs (NES 2.13–2.61, FDR q=0.001), together with a proliferation (E2F) signal, and coordinated down-regulation of UV-response-DN and protein-secretion programs (NES -2.12 and -2.00, FDR q=0.001). The immune/inflammatory up-regulation is the dominant, internally consistent theme across multiple top pathways with overlapping leading-edge genes (e.g., STAT1, CXCL9/10/11, ISG15, CD74, HLA genes), indicating a shared molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Enrichment is computed against a heterogeneous rest (74 samples combining K3_C0002 and K3_C0003), so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
FDR q-values reflect GSEA multiple-testing adjustment, not biological importance.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
Pathway enrichment characterizes phenotype only and does not establish clinical validity or support any accept/drop/split/merge action.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0002 shows a coherent metabolic/mitochondrial transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of protein secretion/vesicular trafficking (NES 2.91), oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.87), fatty-acid metabolism (NES 2.33), adipogenesis (NES 2.11), and mTORC1 signaling (NES 2.01), all at FDR q=0.001, with peroxisome and bile-acid programs also up. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0001 shows a coherent, strongly enriched transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of allograft-rejection/immune, interferon-alpha and -gamma, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory programs (NES 2.13–2.61, FDR q=0.001), together with a proliferation (E2F) signal, and coordinated down-regulation of UV-response-DN and protein-secretion programs (NES -2.12 and -2.00, FDR q=0.001). The immune/inflammatory up-regulation is the dominant, internally consistent theme across multiple top pathways with overlapping leading-edge genes (e.g., STAT1, CXCL9/10/11, ISG15, CD74, HLA genes), indicating a shared molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. This characterizes a biological identity for the candidate; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Enrichment is computed against a heterogeneous rest (74 samples combining K3_C0002 and K3_C0003), so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
FDR q-values reflect GSEA multiple-testing adjustment, not biological importance.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
Pathway enrichment characterizes phenotype only and does not establish clinical validity or support any accept/drop/split/merge action.

These are univariable distance-based associations, not causal contributions, and factor R² values must not be summed. PERMDISP indicates significant dispersion heterogeneity for CT phase and manufacturer, so those PERMANOVA signals may reflect both location and dispersion; PERMDISP is nonsignificant for tissue source site and non-estimable for kernel and scanner model. This partition-scope evidence describes a partition-wide technical concern and does not by itself establish target-specific confounding for any candidate.
limitations: Association is not causation; significant PERMANOVA/distance-regression results do not prove technical artifact, and nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, the six pairwise native patient-geometry concordance estimates (GRV) are all positive but small (0.092-0.198). Three pairs are statistically supported under permutation (WSI-RNA 0.198, CT-WSI 0.167, RNA-WXS 0.145; p=0.001 each), while CT-RNA (0.092, p=0.071), WSI-WXS (0.092, p=0.096), and CT-WXS (0.103, p=0.218) are not distinguishable from the permutation null. Synthesizing jointly rather than by vote counting, the overall pattern indicates weak but partially coherent shared structure across modalities, with the strongest concordance involving WSI and RNA and the weakest involving CT-WXS. GRV is a partition-level measure of shared structure between native distance matrices and is not mechanistic agreement or independent validation.
limitations: GRV measures overall shared structure between native distance matrices and is not mechanistic agreement or independent validation.
Bootstrap intervals are wide relative to the point estimates, and three of six pairs are not distinguishable from the permutation null.

actions.reason: The K3_C0001–K3_C0002 boundary is the weakest of the three pairs: native-geometry silhouettes are positive but small in all four modalities (CT 0.121, WSI 0.085, RNA 0.057, WXS 0.017) with negative fractions up to 0.45, and WXS shows essentially no within-versus-between distinction (median 0.0). Structurally the pair is conflicting rather than supportive: normalized-cut cost is the highest of the three pairs (0.657) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.572), which is merge-compatible and cannot be read as preserving the boundary. By contrast, the K3_C0001–K3_C0003 boundary shows the strongest structural support (ARI 0.930, within 0.622 vs between 0.217, lowest normalized-cut 0.532, and a candidate_k=2 union resolution aligned with the current two-way structure), and the K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundary is intermediate (ARI 0.698, within 0.557 vs between 0.234, normalized-cut 0.592). Because the weakest, most merge-compatible boundary is K3_C0001–K3_C0002, the provisional revision is to merge these two sets into a single unit, leaving the better-supported K3_C0001–K3_C0003 and K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundaries intact for re-review.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. The dominant signal is a strongly up-regulated oxidative-phosphorylation/metabolic program (OXPHOS NES 3.26, fatty-acid metabolism 2.69, adipogenesis 2.44, peroxisome 2.26, mTORC1 2.30, all FDR q=0.001), accompanied by up-regulated protein secretion, UPR, glycolysis, ROS handling, and bile-acid/xenobiotic metabolism, and by down-regulated immune/allograft-rejection (NES -1.74) and myogenesis (NES -1.64) programs. The metabolic-oxidative core is internally consistent across multiple related pathways and survives multiplicity adjustment at q=0.001, indicating a coherent molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. Several additional pathways (MYC targets, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, EMT, KRAS, WNT, IL6-JAK-STAT3, NOTCH, complement, TGF-beta) do not reach FDR q<0.05 and are not multiplicity-robust. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The partition-level structural screen reported a dominant single-cluster resolution with no internal subdivision signal, and within-set affinities exceeding between-set affinities. The transcriptomic phenotype here is a set-versus-rest contrast within a three-set partition, so the 'rest' combines the other two candidate sets and may be heterogeneous; the reciprocal contrast for the other sets is not an independent confirmation. No mutation-based biological report is available for this set to cross-check the metabolic program.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. The dominant signal is a strongly up-regulated oxidative-phosphorylation/metabolic program (OXPHOS NES 3.26, fatty-acid metabolism 2.69, adipogenesis 2.44, peroxisome 2.26, mTORC1 2.30, all FDR q=0.001), accompanied by up-regulated protein secretion, UPR, glycolysis, ROS handling, and bile-acid/xenobiotic metabolism, and by down-regulated immune/allograft-rejection (NES -1.74) and myogenesis (NES -1.64) programs. The metabolic-oxidative core is internally consistent across multiple related pathways and survives multiplicity adjustment at q=0.001, indicating a coherent molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. Several additional pathways (MYC targets, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, EMT, KRAS, WNT, IL6-JAK-STAT3, NOTCH, complement, TGF-beta) do not reach FDR q<0.05 and are not multiplicity-robust. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
reports.cross_evidence_context: The partition-level structural screen reported a dominant single-cluster resolution with no internal subdivision signal, and within-set affinities exceeding between-set affinities. The transcriptomic phenotype here is a set-versus-rest contrast within a three-set partition, so the 'rest' combines the other two candidate sets and may be heterogeneous; the reciprocal contrast for the other sets is not an independent confirmation. No mutation-based biological report is available for this set to cross-check the metabolic program.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
FDR q-values reflect multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Leading-edge gene overlap across pathways can reflect shared programs and does not establish mechanism.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
No mutation-based biological report is available for this set to corroborate the transcriptomic program.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. The dominant signal is a strongly up-regulated oxidative-phosphorylation/metabolic program (OXPHOS NES 3.26, fatty-acid metabolism 2.69, adipogenesis 2.44, peroxisome 2.26, mTORC1 2.30, all FDR q=0.001), accompanied by up-regulated protein secretion, UPR, glycolysis, ROS handling, and bile-acid/xenobiotic metabolism, and by down-regulated immune/allograft-rejection (NES -1.74) and myogenesis (NES -1.64) programs. The metabolic-oxidative core is internally consistent across multiple related pathways and survives multiplicity adjustment at q=0.001, indicating a coherent molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. Several additional pathways (MYC targets, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, EMT, KRAS, WNT, IL6-JAK-STAT3, NOTCH, complement, TGF-beta) do not reach FDR q<0.05 and are not multiplicity-robust. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
FDR q-values reflect multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Leading-edge gene overlap across pathways can reflect shared programs and does not establish mechanism.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
No mutation-based biological report is available for this set to corroborate the transcriptomic program.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a weak and largely non-robust mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. Two driver-panel genes (BAP1, VHL) are nominally enriched (p=0.024 and p=0.036) with odds ratios above one, but neither survives within-driver-panel FDR (q_driver=0.272) or global FDR (q_global=1.0). Several drivers show non-significant direction-of-effect trends (KDM5C and TP53 toward depletion; PBRM1, MTOR, PIK3CA, PTEN, SETD2, TSC1, TSC2, ARID1A, ELOC, KMT2C null), and CDKN2A is not estimable because neither group has events. Exploratory top genes show nominal enrichment with extremely wide intervals and no global significance. Overall the mutation profile does not provide a coherent, multiplicity-robust molecular program distinguishing this set; it characterizes biological identity only and does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous.

reports.dimension_interpretation: For this set, the four native patient geometries provide weak and largely non-supportive membership representation. RNA shows a small positive mean silhouette (0.088) with a 21.2% negative fraction, while CT (-0.056), WSI (-0.114), and WXS (-0.040) show negative mean silhouettes with negative fractions of 45.5-69.7%. Synthesized jointly rather than by vote counting, the overall native-view pattern provides weak, partially conflicting evidence that current membership is expressed in the available geometries: one view shows modest positive separation while three show none or negative separation, and in CT and WSI a majority of patients are closer to a competing label than to their own. In CT, WSI, and WXS the nearest competing set is K3_C0003, indicating that in those geometries this set is closest to K3_C0003 rather than to its paired partner S2. This bears on membership representation but does not by itself determine accept or drop and does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

Prior biological reports for this set (weak, non-robust mutation phenotype) and for S2 (coherent transcriptomic metabolic-oxidative program) are separate evidence dimensions and do not alter this geometry interpretation.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence only. The internal screen shows a dominant single-cluster resolution in all three sets (candidate_k=1, large leading eigengaps 0.80-0.96 with sharp drop-off), so no obvious internal subdivision signal is present at screening resolution. Within-set affinities (0.51-0.68) exceed between-set affinities (0.22-0.24), and the nearest competing pair is S1-S2. This pattern is coherent at the partition level but does not by itself establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.
limitations: Partition-level screening does not provide actual feasible k>=2 solutions or their measurements; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. The dominant signal is a strongly up-regulated oxidative-phosphorylation/metabolic program (OXPHOS NES 3.26, fatty-acid metabolism 2.69, adipogenesis 2.44, peroxisome 2.26, mTORC1 2.30, all FDR q=0.001), accompanied by up-regulated protein secretion, UPR, glycolysis, ROS handling, and bile-acid/xenobiotic metabolism, and by down-regulated immune/allograft-rejection (NES -1.74) and myogenesis (NES -1.64) programs. The metabolic-oxidative core is internally consistent across multiple related pathways and survives multiplicity adjustment at q=0.001, indicating a coherent molecular program rather than isolated pathway hits. Several additional pathways (MYC targets, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, EMT, KRAS, WNT, IL6-JAK-STAT3, NOTCH, complement, TGF-beta) do not reach FDR q<0.05 and are not multiplicity-robust. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Ranking uses the unshrunken DESeq2 Wald statistic, not adjusted p-values or shrunken fold changes.
FDR q-values reflect multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Leading-edge gene overlap across pathways can reflect shared programs and does not establish mechanism.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
No mutation-based biological report is available for this set to corroborate the transcriptomic program.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This set shows a weak and largely non-robust mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the current partition. Two driver-panel genes (BAP1, VHL) are nominally enriched (p=0.024 and p=0.036) with odds ratios above one, but neither survives within-driver-panel FDR (q_driver=0.272) or global FDR (q_global=1.0). Several drivers show non-significant direction-of-effect trends (KDM5C and TP53 toward depletion; PBRM1, MTOR, PIK3CA, PTEN, SETD2, TSC1, TSC2, ARID1A, ELOC, KMT2C null), and CDKN2A is not estimable because neither group has events. Exploratory top genes show nominal enrichment with extremely wide intervals and no global significance. Overall the mutation profile does not provide a coherent, multiplicity-robust molecular program distinguishing this set; it characterizes biological identity only and does not establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
limitations: Set-versus-rest contrast in a three-set partition: the rest combines multiple candidate sets and may be heterogeneous.
Driver panel is a post-hoc prespecified ccRCC biological annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion.
q_driver (within-driver-panel FDR) must not be conflated with q_global (FDR across the complete tested-gene family).
Exploratory top genes are a limited display subset only; every interpretation-matrix gene participates in q_global.
Zero-cell Haldane-Anscombe correction was applied to some odds ratios and intervals; Fisher p-values use the original uncorrected table.
CDKN2A is not estimable (no events in either group); non-estimability is neither support nor contradiction.

actions.reason: Membership is broadly unsupported: three of four native geometries (CT -0.056, WSI -0.114, WXS -0.040) give negative mean silhouettes with 45.5-69.7% of patients closer to a competing label, and in CT/WSI/WXS the nearest competitor is K3_C0003 rather than its paired partner S2 (ER set:4fac32ffe4). The S1-S2 boundary is only weak/partially conflicting (all silhouettes 0.020-0.125, negative fractions 0.16-0.37) and the S1-K3_C0003 boundary is weak and materially conflicting (CT 0.016 and WXS 0.025 essentially no separation) (pair:09956734ff, pair:b591229ca5). Biological identity is weak and non-robust: BAP1/VHL nominal only, neither surviving q_driver=0.272 or q_global=1.0 (wxs:4fac32ffe4). No supported split or merge remains available to rescue it, and no remaining evidence could change this conclusion.

Membership is broadly unsupported: RNA, WSI, and WXS give negative mean silhouettes (-0.060, -0.093, -0.097) with 66.7-81.0% of patients closer to a competing label, and in CT/RNA/WSI the nearest competitor is K3_C0003 rather than S1 (ER set:a07ccf1da6). The S1-S2 boundary is weak/partially conflicting (silhouettes 0.020-0.125) and the S2-K3_C0003 boundary is weak with WSI showing a negative median silhouette and 51.4% negative fraction (pair:09956734ff, pair:7765f2812a). The coherent OXPHOS/metabolic transcriptomic program (rna:a07ccf1da6) is interpretable biology but does not establish that current membership or boundary deserves independent retention, and no supported split or merge remains to rescue it.

K3_C0003 has a substantive interpretable biological identity (PBRM1 OR 3.72, p=0.0057, 17/28 vs 22/75; VHL OR 2.71, p=0.045; BAP1 trend toward depletion) (wxs:c3d03e2c9e) and is the only set with coherent positive membership representation across all four native geometries (WSI 0.301, RNA 0.091, WXS 0.095, CT 0.032; negative fractions 7.1-28.6%) (set:c3d03e2c9e). Its decision-relevant boundaries are not merge-compatible: the S2-K3_C0003 boundary is weak with WSI negative median and 51.4% negative fraction (pair:7765f2812a), and the S1-K3_C0003 boundary is weak and materially conflicting (CT 0.016, WXS 0.025) (pair:b591229ca5), so neither neighboring candidate is supported for union with K3_C0003. No internal subdivision signal is present at screening resolution (partition structural screen, candidate_k=1).
